title: Lantern Market Lanes
premise: A night market on the old quay has become the last safe place to study the uplink. The stalls stand empty, the lanterns still burn, and the crowd that never left is coming back through the lanes.
opening: The gate at the lane's end is chained. The lantern-lit stalls hide the study terminals you need.

rooms.title: Gate Stall
rooms.description: The chained gate stall, its counter scrubbed clean and one lantern box left on top.

rooms.title: Skewer Row
rooms.description: A row of cooking counters under paper lanterns, one bottle still standing where the cook left it.

rooms.title: Lantern Square
rooms.description: The meeting square under a ring of lantern posts, a cafe table left mid-hand of cards.

rooms.title: Crate Yard
rooms.description: The storage yard behind the lanes, crates stacked against a shelf that survived the rush.

relationships.detail: They ran the quay stall together before the lanes emptied and still split every find down the middle.
Rae taught Lena to read the uplink handshake behind the lantern row; neither has said why they stopped talking.
